[{"name":"up_gap_regularity","idea":"How regular the user's repurchase gaps for the product are (coefficient of variation of gaps), and days since the user's last purchase divided by the product's typical 90-day median repurchase gap across all buyers.","level":"pair","sql":"WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), op AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.order_id, l.product_id, l.ts FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id), g AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, epoch(ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, product_id ORDER BY ts, order_id)) / 86400.0 AS gap_d FROM op), ug AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, count(gap_d) AS n_g, avg(gap_d) AS m_g, stddev_pop(gap_d) AS s_g FROM g GROUP BY user_id, product_id), ls AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, max(ts) AS last_ts FROM op GROUP BY user_id, product_id), pg AS (SELECT product_id, median(gap_d) AS med_gap FROM (SELECT product_id, epoch(ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, product_id ORDER BY ts, order_id)) / 86400.0 AS gap_d FROM (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, order_id, product_id, ts FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY) x) y WHERE gap_d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, CASE WHEN ug.n_g >= 2 AND ug.m_g > 0 THEN ug.s_g / ug.m_g ELSE NULL END AS ag_up_gap_cv, (epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - ls.last_ts) / 86400.0) / greatest(pg.med_gap, 1.0) AS ag_up_due_pmed FROM cand c JOIN ls ON ls.user_id = c.user_id AND ls.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN ug ON ug.user_id = c.user_id AND ug.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN pg ON pg.product_id = c.product_id;"},
{"name":"up_rebuy_freq_bucket","idea":"Pseudo-label rate learned at A-14d per product: among users with the same number of prior distinct orders containing the product (1, 2, 3-4, 5-7, 8+) as this user now, the share whose first order in the next 14 days contained it, smoothed toward the bucket-wide rate.","level":"pair","sql":"WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), fo AS (SELECT user_id, order_id FROM (SELECT user_id, order_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS rk FROM orders WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY) x WHERE rk = 1), fl AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.order_id, l.product_id FROM lines l JOIN fo ON l.order_id = fo.order_id), h AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.product_id, count(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS n FROM lines l JOIN fo ON l.user_id = fo.user_id WHERE l.ts < TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY l.user_id, l.product_id), hb AS (SELECT h.product_id, CASE WHEN h.n = 1 THEN 0 WHEN h.n = 2 THEN 1 WHEN h.n <= 4 THEN 2 WHEN h.n <= 7 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS b, CASE WHEN fl.order_id IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE 1.0 END AS hit FROM h JOIN fo ON fo.user_id = h.user_id LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.order_id = fo.order_id AND fl.product_id = h.product_id), pb AS (SELECT product_id, b, count(*) AS n, sum(hit) AS k FROM hb GROUP BY product_id, b), bb AS (SELECT b, sum(k) / sum(n) AS pr FROM pb GROUP BY b), cur AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.product_id, count(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS n FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id GROUP BY l.user_id, l.product_id), cb AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, CASE WHEN n = 1 THEN 0 WHEN n = 2 THEN 1 WHEN n <= 4 THEN 2 WHEN n <= 7 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS b FROM cur) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, (COALESCE(pb.k, 0) + 20.0 * bb.pr) / (COALESCE(pb.n, 0) + 20.0) AS ag_pr_rebuy_freq FROM cand c JOIN cb ON cb.user_id = c.user_id AND cb.product_id = c.product_id JOIN bb ON bb.b = cb.b LEFT JOIN pb ON pb.product_id = cb.product_id AND pb.b = cb.b;"},
{"name":"up_price_vs_paid_v2","idea":"Clipped log ratio of the product's current 7-day median price at the user's main retailer (global 7-day median as fallback) to the price the user paid at the last purchase, guarded against zero prices.","level":"pair","sql":"WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), um AS (SELECT user_id, retailer FROM (SELECT o.user_id, o.retailer, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(o.ts) DESC, o.retailer) AS rk FROM orders o JOIN cu ON o.user_id = cu.user_id GROUP BY o.user_id, o.retailer) x WHERE rk = 1), lp AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, price FROM (SELECT l.user_id, l.product_id, l.price, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.user_id, l.product_id ORDER BY l.ts DESC, l.order_id DESC, l.line_item_id DESC) AS rk FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id) y WHERE rk = 1 AND price > 0), rp AS (SELECT o.retailer, l.product_id, median(l.price) AS mp FROM lines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id WHERE l.ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND o.retailer IN (SELECT retailer FROM um) GROUP BY o.retailer, l.product_id), gp AS (SELECT product_id, median(price) AS mp FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(rp.mp, gp.mp) > 0 THEN ln(least(greatest(COALESCE(rp.mp, gp.mp) / lp.price, 0.01), 100.0)) ELSE NULL END AS ag_up_price_vs_paid FROM cand c JOIN lp ON lp.user_id = c.user_id AND lp.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN um ON um.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN rp ON rp.retailer = um.retailer AND rp.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN gp ON gp.product_id = c.product_id;"},
{"name":"retailer_adopt14","idea":"Pseudo-label adoption rate at A-14d at the user's main retailer: share of returning users whose first order in the last 14 days was at that retailer, had never bought the product before, and added it in that order.","level":"pair","sql":"WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), um AS (SELECT user_id, retailer FROM (SELECT o.user_id, o.retailer, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(o.ts) DESC, o.retailer) AS rk FROM orders o JOIN cu ON o.user_id = cu.user_id GROUP BY o.user_id, o.retailer) x WHERE rk = 1), fo AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, retailer FROM (SELECT user_id, order_id, retailer, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS rk FROM orders WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY) x WHERE rk = 1), pu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM orders WHERE ts < TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY), co AS (SELECT fo.user_id, fo.order_id, fo.retailer FROM fo JOIN pu ON fo.user_id = pu.user_id WHERE fo.retailer IN (SELECT retailer FROM um)), rn AS (SELECT retailer, count(*) AS n_r FROM co GROUP BY retailer), pv AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.product_id FROM lines l JOIN co ON l.user_id = co.user_id WHERE l.ts < TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY), pr AS (SELECT co.retailer, pv.product_id, count(*) AS n_prev FROM pv JOIN co ON pv.user_id = co.user_id GROUP BY co.retailer, pv.product_id), fl AS (SELECT DISTINCT co.retailer, l.user_id, l.product_id FROM lines l JOIN co ON l.order_id = co.order_id), fa AS (SELECT fl.retailer, fl.product_id, count(*) AS n_adopt FROM fl LEFT JOIN pv ON pv.user_id = fl.user_id AND pv.product_id = fl.product_id WHERE pv.user_id IS NULL GROUP BY fl.retailer, fl.product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, (COALESCE(fa.n_adopt, 0) + 0.1) / (greatest(rn.n_r - COALESCE(pr.n_prev, 0), 0) + 100.0) * 1000.0 AS ag_pr_adopt14_main FROM cand c JOIN um ON um.user_id = c.user_id JOIN rn ON rn.retailer = um.retailer LEFT JOIN fa ON fa.retailer = um.retailer AND fa.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN pr ON pr.retailer = um.retailer AND pr.product_id = c.product_id;"},
{"name":"last_retailer_fit","idea":"Fit of the candidate to the retailer of the user's latest order: share of the user's purchases of the product made at that retailer, and log distinct buyers of the product at that retailer in the last 7 days (current availability).","level":"pair","sql":"WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), lo AS (SELECT user_id, retailer FROM (SELECT o.user_id, o.retailer, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY o.ts DESC, o.order_id DESC) AS rk FROM orders o JOIN cu ON o.user_id = cu.user_id) x WHERE rk = 1), ul AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.order_id, l.product_id, o.retailer FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id), up AS (SELECT ul.user_id, ul.product_id, avg(CASE WHEN ul.retailer = lo.retailer THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS sh FROM ul JOIN lo ON lo.user_id = ul.user_id GROUP BY ul.user_id, ul.product_id), av AS (SELECT o.retailer, l.product_id, count(DISTINCT l.user_id) AS nb FROM lines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id WHERE l.ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND o.retailer IN (SELECT retailer FROM lo) GROUP BY o.retailer, l.product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, up.sh AS ag_up_lastret_share, ln(1.0 + COALESCE(av.nb, 0)) AS ag_p_lastret_buyers7 FROM cand c JOIN lo ON lo.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN up ON up.user_id = c.user_id AND up.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN av ON av.retailer = lo.retailer AND av.product_id = c.product_id;"}]
